initial_prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: actual modular 2D RGBA sprite for a Minecraft realtime weapon-flame VFX system. The two inputs are existing trail/scatter textures, use their chunky red-orange outer blocks, amber body and pale yellow core as visual references. Rework that material into the single requested reusable module, rather than copying the entire composite. Flat orthographic texture, true transparent RGBA background and transparent negative spaces; no black backdrop, no checkerboard drawn in, no text, no frames, no scene, no sword, no characters. Minecraft low-resolution pixel art with coarse clearly visible square texels on a consistent axis-aligned grid (roughly 64 to 96 texels along the sprite length), hard nearest-neighbor stair-step silhouette and clustered flat colors. Restrained palette: dark burnt red, red-orange, orange, golden yellow, cream yellow. Separate the broad dark rim, thick luminous body and broken hot core. No soft glow, no blur, no antialiasing, no smooth gradients, no perspective mosaic parallelograms. No lightning, electric branches, vines, hair-thin lines or long thin ribbons. Every end must fit completely inside the canvas with generous transparent padding. No extraneous surrounding particles unless specified. Output only one isolated sprite ready to be rotated/scaled and combined with other modules. Module 1 MAIN ARC SEGMENT: a substantial thick slightly curving block of burning energy, shallow bent arc spanning ONLY about 35 degrees, oriented left to right. Outer width-to-height bounding-box ratio around 3:1, band thickness about 30 percent of its length. Mostly continuous chunky mass, squared-off stepped ends, two or three deep rectangular edge bites and interrupted cream core islands. Ends moderately tapered yet broad for overlap with next segment. Absolutely not a whole crescent, ring, swoosh or complete attack trajectory.

tail_refinement: Edit this existing tail sprite into a SMALL FADING TAIL FRAGMENT for a Minecraft flame VFX module. Keep its red-orange chunky pixel material. Replace the long multi-part arrangement with ONE compact asymmetrical stepped ember block, only 1.6 times wider than tall, with a very shallow bend and large square bites. Mostly dark burnt red and orange, just ONE tiny warm-yellow square, no bright cream large core. Coarse axis aligned square pixel clusters, hard edges, no glow or antialiasing. No surrounding detached specks or long trailing line. Real transparent background. VERY IMPORTANT leave an entirely transparent margin of at least 20 percent of canvas on EVERY side. Every part must be completely within the central 60 percent of canvas. No shapes or stray pixels at canvas edges. Output one sprite, no labels or panels.
